So far, 10 feature flows covering 15 approved scenarios are settled:

- Enriched saving with automatic page details and readable copies
- Honest recovery for invalid or unreachable pages
- Smart duplicate detection and updating
- Editing titles, descriptions, notes, and consistent tags
- Search across titles, descriptions, and notes
- Sidebar tag browsing
- Opening originals—or saved copies—in new tabs
- Reversible Read later management
- Safe deletion and cancellation
- Clear empty, long-content, and failure states

May I start implementing this scope?
